tei:titleStmt.tei:title: שְׂאוּ לְבַבְכֶם לְכַפֵּיכֶם
Səū l'Vavkhem l'Khapeikhem, an ofan piyyuṭ for the Shabbat before Rosh haShanah by Rabbi Isaac ben Moses

tei:div.tei:head: Səū l'Vavkhem l'Khapeikhem, an ofan piyyuṭ for the Shabbat before Rosh haShanah by Rabbi Isaac ben Moses

tei:lg.tei:l: Raise your hearts in your hands, and pray wash and be cleansed,
and turn away and pass from foolish sights, and cling to revering the Deity!
Israel, set right your heart and be just
on the coming day, investigate guilt and righteous hearts and also merit
and grant might to the Sovereign of might and Their Temple’s glory.
Exalt the Cause our God and bow to Their holy mountain! (Psalms 99:9)
Gather together and sanctify the Living One dwelling on a throne.
Pray blast a long blast and a tremulous blast on the covered day of our festival,
and quake and confess to turn away evil deeds,
and tear the heart and come to tears before the face of the Deity who bears iniquity,
for over all a voice will pass and fulfill their just deserts.
Exalt the Cause our God and bow to Their holy mountain! (Psalms 99:9)
Exalt the Rock with a steady heart, on calling the holy gathering.
Yoke together petition with cheering, like a gift to bring near in holiness.
Desire to purify an anxious heart, renew a prepared spirit!
Acquire Your people which is supported by You, distinguished in awe, and sanctify
the pure of heart; think of the crushed like a gift-offering in holiness
on the day of offering up great iniquity on the first of the seventh month.
Extend Your mercy, that Your servants be renewed in a new spirit.
Exalt the Cause our God and bow to Their holy mountain! (Psalms 99:9)
O those of on high, in great might, Michael and Gabriel,
raise your voice for your people, the children of Jacob and Israel!
Array praised prayer, Raphael and Hadraniel,
and snake-angels for the thousands, shout out, hurry to Uzziel,
and living-angels, array with all mouths petition to Malkiel.
Building Their city in Their great splendor is what Their people ask,
that the scattered be gathered to fulfill the word of the Deity.
Pass before them, their king, on the day of their law; and the Cause will go at the head!
Exalt the Cause our God and bow to Their holy mountain! (Psalms 99:9)
The Metatron will shout aloud to open straightaway
the merit of the patriarchs and matriarchs, the remembrance of the mercy of youth,
and the slain and burnt in burning igniting fire,
to sanctify the name with property and body, arousing with all their strength.
And the pure Teaching that is returned into the people’s mouth,
encourage merit to teach its matters to the afflicted
in many stresses and lackings, who are exiled to all the gates.
Spill out petition before the Merciful to glorify the place of Their temple!
Exalt the Cause our God and bow to Their holy mountain! (Psalms 99:9)

tei:note.tei:p: Rosh haShanah, the first day of the seventh month.
Or possibly, “the Deity, my strength.” In some manuscripts, written as two words rather than one.
Or possibly, “the Deity, my Sovereign.” In some manuscripts, written as two words rather than one.
